title: cps-okf — /okf/validate result (the safety plan)
description: The deterministic response of POST /okf/validate. Takes the OKF as presented by an LLM and returns, per concept, WHAT IS SAFE to do and HOW — create / update / edit, or review / reject. The model reads this plan and executes the safe items via the MCP write tools / in-app actions. The plan is an advisory pre-flight + linter, NOT the security boundary: the real write endpoints re-check access server-side, and review/reject items require a human. See docs/api.md and ADR-0006.

conformant.description: Schema-level conformance of the whole payload.

concept.description: Bundle-relative path of the concept this verdict is for.

objectId.description: Resolved existing id (→ update/edit) or null (→ create).

verdict.description: create = safe new insert. update = safe period-scoped change (status/analysis/recommendations/data/period customField). edit = safe definitional change (name/links/dates/edit customField). review = ambiguous identity, sub-threshold confidence, referential gap, or insufficient capability — human required. reject = schema-invalid or forbidden (no access / marking / locked).

action.description: How the model should apply a safe (create/update/edit) item. Grounded in the real ClearPoint write surface.

mcpTool.description: Real MCP write tool: mcpAdd=create, mcpEdit=edit definition, mcpEditLinks=links, mcpUpdate=status/period, mcpUpdateData=measure data.

confidence.description: cps.provenance.resolved.confidence if this node was derived; drives review below threshold.

reasons.description: Why this verdict — e.g. 'objectId matches; period-scoped status change', 'confidence 0.62 < 0.80', 'element locked', 'no Editor access on scorecard 7'.

resolutions.description: Per-reference resolution of by-name references against the target account's lookups (users/statuses/periods/custom-fields/glossary/scorecards). Fuzzy-match with confidence; feeds the verdict (sub-threshold must-exist ref -> review/reject; missing creatable -> create). This is the cps-parse _map/confidence/unresolved model, reading the bundle's lookups.

field.description: Where in the concept the reference sits, e.g. 'provenance.owner', 'status.currentPeriod', 'details.Budget', 'link:measures[0]'.

refType.description: What kind of entity is referenced.

selector.description: The free-text reference being resolved (name/label), after glossary aliasing.

status.description: resolved = confident id; ambiguous = candidates, sub-threshold; unresolved = no match on a must-exist ref; create = creatable and absent (new element / field / status config).
